Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

title: Life of Brian
tagline: He's not the messiah...he's just a naughty boy.
casting: Graham Chapman, John Cleese, Terry Gilliam, Eric Idle, Terry Jones
synopsis: Brian Cohen is an average young Jewish man, but through a series of ridiculous events, he gains a reputation as the Messiah. When he's not dodging his followers or being scolded by his shrill mother, the hapless Brian has to contend with the pompous Pontius Pilate and acronym-obsessed members of a separatist movement. Rife with Monty Python's signature absurdity, the tale finds Brian's life paralleling Biblical lore, albeit with many more laughs.

title: Ponyo
tagline: Welcome to a world where anything is possible.
casting: Yuria Kozuki, Hiroki Doi, George Tokoro, Tomoko Yamaguchi, Yuki Amami
synopsis: When Sosuke, a young boy who lives on a clifftop overlooking the sea, rescues a stranded goldfish named Ponyo, he discovers more than he bargained for. Ponyo is a curious, energetic young creature who yearns to be human, but even as she causes chaos around the house, her father, a powerful sorcerer, schemes to return Ponyo to the sea.

title: Donnie Darko
tagline: 28 days, 6 hours, 42 minutes, 12 seconds... that is when the world will end.
casting: Jake Gyllenhaal, Jena Malone, James Duval, Drew Barrymore, Beth Grant
synopsis: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a large bunny rabbit that manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

title: Tetris
tagline: The game you couldn't put down. The story you couldn't make up.
casting: Taron Egerton, Nikita Efremov, Sofia Lebedeva, Anthony Boyle, Ben Miles
synopsis: In 1988, American video game salesman Henk Rogers discovers the video game Tetris. When he sets out to bring the game to the world, he enters a dangerous web of lies and corruption behind the Iron Curtain.

title: The Hateful Eight
tagline: No one comes up here without a damn good reason.
casting: Samuel L. Jackson, Kurt Russell, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Walton Goggins, Demián Bichir
synopsis: Bounty hunters seek shelter from a raging blizzard and get caught up in a plot of betrayal and deception.

title: Misery
tagline: Paul Sheldon used to write for a living. Now, he’s writing to stay alive.
casting: Kathy Bates, James Caan, Richard Farnsworth, Lauren Bacall, Frances Sternhagen
synopsis: After an accident, acclaimed novelist Paul Sheldon is rescued by a nurse who claims to be his biggest fan.  Her obsession takes a dark turn when she holds him captive in her remote Colorado home and forces him to write back to life the popular literary character he killed off.

title: The Untouchables
tagline: What are you prepared to do?
casting: Kevin Costner, Sean Connery, Robert De Niro, Charles Martin Smith, Andy Garcia
synopsis: Elliot Ness, an ambitious prohibition agent, is determined to take down Al Capone. In order to achieve this goal, he forms a group given the nickname “The Untouchables”.

title: The Whale
tagline: I need to know that I have done one thing right with my life.
casting: Brendan Fraser, Sadie Sink, Ty Simpkins, Hong Chau, Samantha Morton
synopsis: A reclusive English teacher suffering from severe obesity attempts to reconnect with his estranged teenage daughter for one last chance at redemption.

title: Train to Busan
tagline: Life-or-death survival begins.
casting: Gong Yoo, Kim Su-an, Jung Yu-mi, Don Lee, Choi Woo-shik
synopsis: When a zombie virus pushes Korea into a state of emergency, those trapped on an express train to Busan must fight for their own survival.

title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
tagline: Fly on your own. Find your way home.
casting: Jay Baruchel, America Ferrera, F. Murray Abraham, Cate Blanchett, Gerard Butler
synopsis: As Hiccup fulfills his dream of creating a peaceful dragon utopia, Toothless’ discovery of an untamed, elusive mate draws the Night Fury away. When danger mounts at home and Hiccup’s reign as village chief is tested, both dragon and rider must make impossible decisions to save their kind.

title: The Exorcist
tagline: Something almost beyond comprehension is happening to a girl on this street, in this house…And a man has been sent for as a last resort. This man is The Exorcist.
casting: Ellen Burstyn, Linda Blair, Jason Miller, Max von Sydow, Lee J. Cobb
synopsis: When a mysterious entity possesses a young girl, her mother seeks the help of two Catholic priests to save her life.

title: Rain Man
tagline: A journey through understanding and fellowship.
casting: Dustin Hoffman, Tom Cruise, Valeria Golino, Gerald R. Molen, Jack Murdock
synopsis: When car dealer Charlie Babbitt learns that his estranged father has died, he returns home to Cincinnati, where he discovers that he has a savant older brother named Raymond and that his father's $3 million fortune is being left to the mental institution in which Raymond lives. Motivated by his father's money, Charlie checks Raymond out of the facility in order to return with him to Los Angeles. The brothers' cross-country trip ends up changing both their lives.

title: The Chorus
casting: Gérard Jugnot, François Berléand, Kad Merad, Jean-Paul Bonnaire, Marie Bunel
synopsis: In 1940s France, a new teacher at a school for disruptive boys gives hope and inspiration.

title: A Man Called Otto
tagline: Fall in love with the grumpiest man in America.
casting: Tom Hanks, Mariana Treviño, Cameron Britton, Mack Bayda, Manuel Garcia-Rulfo
synopsis: When a lively young family moves in next door, grumpy widower Otto Anderson meets his match in a quick-witted, pregnant woman named Marisol, leading to an unlikely friendship that turns his world upside down.

title: Rush
tagline: Everyone's driven by something.
casting: Chris Hemsworth, Daniel Brühl, Olivia Wilde, Alexandra Maria Lara, Pierfrancesco Favino
synopsis: In the 1970s, a rivalry propels race car drivers Niki Lauda and James Hunt to fame and glory — until a horrible accident threatens to end it all.

title: Platoon
tagline: The first casualty of war is innocence.
casting: Charlie Sheen, Willem Dafoe, Tom Berenger, Kevin Dillon, Forest Whitaker
synopsis: As a young and naive recruit in Vietnam, Chris Taylor faces a moral crisis when confronted with the horrors of war and the duality of man.

title: A Walk to Remember
tagline: It all comes down to who's by your side.
casting: Mandy Moore, Shane West, Peter Coyote, Daryl Hannah, Lauren German
synopsis: When the popular, restless Landon Carter is forced to participate in the school drama production, he falls in love with Jamie Sullivan, the daughter of the town's minister. Jamie has a "to-do" list for her life, as well as a very big secret she must keep from Landon.

title: Big Fish
tagline: An adventure as big as life itself.
casting: Ewan McGregor, Albert Finney, Billy Crudup, Jessica Lange, Helena Bonham Carter
synopsis: Throughout his life Edward Bloom has always been a man of big appetites, enormous passions and tall tales. In his later years, he remains a huge mystery to his son, William. Now, to get to know the real man, Will begins piecing together a true picture of his father from flashbacks of his amazing adventures.

title: Mystic River
tagline: We bury our sins, we wash them clean.
casting: Sean Penn, Tim Robbins, Kevin Bacon, Laurence Fishburne, Marcia Gay Harden
synopsis: The lives of three men who were childhood friends are shattered when one of them suffers a family tragedy.

title: All Quiet on the Western Front
casting: Felix Kammerer, Albrecht Schuch, Aaron Hilmer, Moritz Klaus, Adrian Grünewald
synopsis: Paul Baumer and his friends Albert and Muller, egged on by romantic dreams of heroism, voluntarily enlist in the German army. Full of excitement and patriotic fervour, the boys enthusiastically march into a war they believe in. But once on the Western Front, they discover the soul-destroying horror of World War I.

title: Dogville
tagline: A quiet little town not far from here.
casting: Nicole Kidman, Paul Bettany, John Hurt, Stellan Skarsgård, Philip Baker Hall
synopsis: A woman on the run from the mob is reluctantly accepted in a small Colorado community in exchange for labor, but when a search visits the town, she learns that their support has a price.

title: Three Steps Above Heaven
tagline: One step to you.
casting: Mario Casas, María Valverde, Álvaro Cervantes, Marina Salas, Luis Fernández
synopsis: Babi, a sheltered upper-class girl, and Hache, a reckless rebel obsessed with illegal motorcycle races, fall into a forbidden love that pulls them deeper into passion and risk.

title: Marriage Story
tagline: Where there's a love, there's a way.
casting: Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson, Laura Dern, Alan Alda, Ray Liotta
synopsis: A stage director and an actress struggle through a grueling, coast-to-coast divorce that pushes them to their personal extremes.

title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
tagline: Nowhere is safe.
casting: Daniel Radcliffe, Emma Watson, Rupert Grint, Toby Jones, Helena Bonham Carter
synopsis: Harry, Ron and Hermione walk away from their last year at Hogwarts to find and destroy the remaining Horcruxes, putting an end to Voldemort's bid for immortality. But with Harry's beloved Dumbledore dead and Voldemort's unscrupulous Death Eaters on the loose, the world is more dangerous than ever.

title: The King's Speech
tagline: Find your voice.
casting: Colin Firth, Geoffrey Rush, Helena Bonham Carter, Guy Pearce, Timothy Spall
synopsis: The King's Speech tells the story of the man who became King George VI, the father of Queen Elizabeth II. After his brother abdicates, George ('Bertie') reluctantly assumes the throne. Plagued by a dreaded stutter and considered unfit to be king, Bertie engages the help of an unorthodox speech therapist named Lionel Logue. Through a set of unexpected techniques, and as a result of an unlikely friendship, Bertie is able to find his voice and boldly lead the country into war.

title: Batman Begins
tagline: Evil fears the knight.
casting: Christian Bale, Michael Caine, Liam Neeson, Katie Holmes, Gary Oldman
synopsis: Driven by tragedy, billionaire Bruce Wayne dedicates his life to uncovering and defeating the corruption that plagues his home, Gotham City.  Unable to work within the system, he instead creates a new identity, a symbol of fear for the criminal underworld - The Batman.

title: The Incredibles
tagline: Super strength can’t carry a family.
casting: Craig T. Nelson, Holly Hunter, Sarah Vowell, Spencer Fox, Jason Lee
synopsis: Bob Parr has given up his superhero days to log in time as an insurance adjuster and raise his three children with his formerly heroic wife in suburbia. But when he receives a mysterious assignment, it's time to get back into costume.

title: The Sound of Music
tagline: The happiest sound in all the world!
casting: Julie Andrews, Christopher Plummer, Eleanor Parker, Charmian Carr, Nicholas Hammond
synopsis: In the years before World War II, a tomboyish postulant at an Austrian abbey is hired as a governess in the home of a widowed naval captain with seven children and brings a new love of life and music into the home.

title: Slumdog Millionaire
tagline: What does it take to find a lost love?
casting: Dev Patel, Freida Pinto, Madhur Mittal, Anil Kapoor, Mahesh Manjrekar
synopsis: A teenager reflects on his life after being accused of cheating on the Indian version of "Who Wants to be a Millionaire?".

title: The Color Purple
tagline: It's about life. It's about love. It's about us.
casting: Danny Glover, Whoopi Goldberg, Margaret Avery, Oprah Winfrey, Willard E. Pugh
synopsis: An epic tale spanning forty years in the life of Celie, an African-American woman living in the South who survives incredible abuse and bigotry. After Celie's abusive father marries her off to the equally debasing 'Mister' Albert Johnson, things go from bad to worse, leaving Celie to find companionship anywhere she can. She perseveres, holding on to her dream of one day being reunited with her sister in Africa.

title: Big Hero 6
tagline: Drop everything. Save the world.
casting: Scott Adsit, Ryan Potter, Daniel Henney, T.J. Miller, Jamie Chung
synopsis: A special bond develops between plus-sized inflatable robot Baymax, and prodigy Hiro Hamada, who team up with a group of friends to form a band of high-tech heroes.

title: Beauty and the Beast
tagline: The most beautiful love story ever told.
casting: Paige O'Hara, Robby Benson, Richard White, Jerry Orbach, David Ogden Stiers
synopsis: Follow the adventures of Belle, a bright young woman who finds herself in the castle of a prince who's been turned into a mysterious beast. With the help of the castle's enchanted staff, Belle soon learns the most important lesson of all -- that true beauty comes from within.

title: My Fault
tagline: Love can only survive in the shadow of secrets.
casting: Nicole Wallace, Gabriel Guevara, Marta Hazas, Iván Sánchez, Eva Ruiz
synopsis: Noah must leave her city, boyfriend, and friends to move into William Leister's mansion, the flashy and wealthy husband of her mother Rafaela. As a proud and independent 17 year old, Noah resists living in a mansion surrounded by luxury. However, it is there where she meets Nick, her new stepbrother, and the clash of their strong personalities becomes evident from the very beginning.

title: Hotel Rwanda
tagline: When the world closed its eyes, he opened his arms.
casting: Don Cheadle, Sophie Okonedo, Nick Nolte, Fana Mokoena, Desmond Dube
synopsis: Inspired by true events, this film takes place in Rwanda in the 1990s when more than a million Tutsis were killed in a genocide that went mostly unnoticed by the rest of the world. Hotel owner Paul Rusesabagina houses over a thousand refuges in his hotel in attempt to save their lives.

title: Edward Scissorhands
tagline: Innocence is what he knows. Beauty is what she sees.
casting: Johnny Depp, Winona Ryder, Dianne Wiest, Anthony Michael Hall, Kathy Baker
synopsis: A small suburban town receives a visit from a castaway unfinished science experiment named Edward.

title: Magnolia
tagline: Things fall down. People look up. And when it rains, it pours.
casting: Tom Cruise, Philip Baker Hall, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Julianne Moore, William H. Macy
synopsis: On one random day in the San Fernando Valley, a dying father, a young wife, a male caretaker, a famous lost son, a police officer in love, a boy genius, an ex-boy genius, a game show host and an estranged daughter will each become part of a dazzling multiplicity of plots, but one story.

title: Guy Ritchie's The Covenant
tagline: A bond. A pledge. A commitment.
casting: Jake Gyllenhaal, Dar Salim, Sean Sagar, Jason Wong, Rhys Yates
synopsis: After an ambush, Afghan interpreter Ahmed goes to Herculean lengths to save US Army Sergeant John Kinley's life. When Kinley learns that Ahmed and his family were not given safe passage to America as promised, he must return to the war zone and repay his debt.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
tagline: The universe is so much bigger than you realize.
casting: Michelle Yeoh, Stephanie Hsu, Ke Huy Quan, James Hong, Jamie Lee Curtis
synopsis: An aging Chinese immigrant is swept up in an insane adventure, where she alone can save what's important to her by connecting with the lives she could have led in other universes.

title: Two Is a Family
casting: Omar Sy, Gloria Colston, Clémence Poésy, Antoine Bertrand, Ashley Walters
synopsis: A man without attachments or responsibilities suddenly finds himself with an abandoned baby and leaves for London to try and find the mother. Eight years later after he and his daughter become inseparable Gloria's mother reappears.

title: The Bridges of Madison County
tagline: A love like this happens to some of us sooner or later. For Robert and Francesca, it was later.
casting: Meryl Streep, Clint Eastwood, Annie Corley, Victor Slezak, Jim Haynie
synopsis: Photographer Robert Kincaid wanders into the life of housewife Francesca Johnson for four days in the 1960s.

title: The Breakfast Club
tagline: They only met once, but it changed their lives forever.
casting: Emilio Estevez, Judd Nelson, Molly Ringwald, Anthony Michael Hall, Ally Sheedy
synopsis: Five high school students from different walks of life endure a Saturday detention under a power-hungry principal. The disparate group includes rebel John, princess Claire, outcast Allison, brainy Brian and Andrew, the jock. Each has a chance to tell his or her story, making the others see them a little differently -- and when the day ends, they question whether school will ever be the same.

title: Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron
tagline: Some legends can never be tamed.
casting: Matt Damon, James Cromwell, Daniel Studi, Chopper Bernet, Jeff LeBeau
synopsis: A captured mustang remains determined to return to his herd no matter what.

title: The Blues Brothers
tagline: They'll never get caught. They're on a mission from God.
casting: John Belushi, Dan Aykroyd, James Brown, Cab Calloway, Ray Charles
synopsis: Just released from prison, Jake Blues puts his old band back together with his brother Elwood to save the Catholic home where they were raised.

title: John Wick: Chapter 4
tagline: No way back, one way out.
casting: Keanu Reeves, Donnie Yen, Bill Skarsgård, Ian McShane, Laurence Fishburne
synopsis: With the price on his head ever increasing, John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.

title: The Martian
tagline: Bring him home.
casting: Matt Damon, Jessica Chastain, Kristen Wiig, Jeff Daniels, Michael Peña
synopsis: During a manned mission to Mars, Astronaut Mark Watney is presumed dead after a fierce storm and left behind by his crew. But Watney has survived and finds himself stranded and alone on the hostile planet. With only meager supplies, he must draw upon his ingenuity, wit and spirit to subsist and find a way to signal to Earth that he is alive.

title: The Princess Bride
tagline: It's as real as the feelings you feel.
casting: Cary Elwes, Robin Wright, Mandy Patinkin, Chris Sarandon, Christopher Guest
synopsis: In this enchantingly cracked fairy tale, the beautiful Princess Buttercup and the dashing Westley must overcome staggering odds to find happiness amid six-fingered swordsmen, murderous princes, Sicilians and rodents of unusual size. But even death can't stop these true lovebirds from triumphing.

title: Annie Hall
tagline: A nervous romance.
casting: Diane Keaton, Woody Allen, Tony Roberts, Carol Kane, Paul Simon
synopsis: New York comedian Alvy Singer falls in love with the ditsy Annie Hall.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
tagline: Something evil has returned to Hogwarts!
casting: Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Kenneth Branagh, Toby Jones
synopsis: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a mysterious house-elf comes to warn Harry Potter at the start of his second year at Hogwarts. Adventure and danger await when bloody writing on a wall announces: The Chamber Of Secrets Has Been Opened. To save Hogwarts will require all of Harry, Ron and Hermione's magical abilities and courage.

title: The Gorge
tagline: The world's most dangerous secret lies between them.
casting: Miles Teller, Anya Taylor-Joy, Sigourney Weaver, Ṣọpẹ́ Dìrísù, William Houston
synopsis: Two highly trained operatives grow close from a distance after being sent to guard opposite sides of a mysterious gorge. When an evil below emerges, they must work together to survive what lies within.

title: Nightcrawler
tagline: The city shines brightest at night.
casting: Jake Gyllenhaal, Rene Russo, Riz Ahmed, Bill Paxton, Kevin Rahm
synopsis: When Lou Bloom, desperate for work, muscles into the world of L.A. crime journalism, he blurs the line between observer and participant to become the star of his own story. Aiding him in his effort is Nina, a TV-news veteran.

title: Sound of Metal
tagline: Music was his world. Then silence revealed a new one.
casting: Riz Ahmed, Olivia Cooke, Paul Raci, Lauren Ridloff, Mathieu Amalric
synopsis: Metal drummer Ruben begins to lose his hearing. When a doctor tells him his condition will worsen, he thinks his career and life is over. His girlfriend Lou checks the former addict into a rehab for the deaf hoping it will prevent a relapse and help him adapt to his new life. After being welcomed and accepted just as he is, Ruben must choose between his new normal and the life he once knew.

title: Philadelphia
tagline: No one would take on his case... until one man was willing to take on the system.
casting: Tom Hanks, Denzel Washington, Jason Robards, Mary Steenburgen, Antonio Banderas
synopsis: Two competing lawyers join forces to sue a prestigious law firm for AIDS discrimination. As their unlikely friendship develops, their courage overcomes the prejudice and corruption of their powerful adversaries.

title: Manhattan
tagline: Woody Allen's New Comedy Hit
casting: Woody Allen, Diane Keaton, Michael Murphy, Mariel Hemingway, Meryl Streep
synopsis: Manhattan explores how the life of a middle-aged television writer dating a teenage girl is further complicated when he falls in love with his best friend's mistress.

title: The Terminator
tagline: Your future is in its hands.
casting: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Michael Biehn, Linda Hamilton, Paul Winfield, Lance Henriksen
synopsis: In the post-apocalyptic future, reigning tyrannical supercomputers teleport a cyborg assassin known as the "Terminator" back to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor, whose unborn son is destined to lead insurgents against 21st century mechanical hegemony. Meanwhile, the human-resistance movement dispatches a lone warrior to safeguard Sarah. Can he stop the virtually indestructible killing machine?

title: Past Lives
tagline: A heartrending modern romance that confronts notions of destiny, love, and the choices that make a life.
casting: Greta Lee, Teo Yoo, John Magaro, Moon Seung-ah, Leem Seung-min
synopsis: After decades apart, childhood friends Nora and Hae Sung are reunited in New York for one fateful weekend as they confront notions of destiny, love, and the choices that make a life.

title: The Warriors
tagline: These are the armies of the night. They are 100,000 strong. They outnumber the cops five to one. They could run New York City. Tonight they're all out to get the Warriors.
casting: Michael Beck, James Remar, David Patrick Kelly, Dorsey Wright, David Harris
synopsis: Prominent gang leader Cyrus calls a meeting of New York's gangs to set aside their turf wars and take over the city. At the meeting, a rival leader kills Cyrus, but a Coney Island gang called the Warriors is wrongly blamed for Cyrus' death. Before you know it, the cops and every gangbanger in town is hot on the Warriors' trail.

title: Little Miss Sunshine
tagline: A family on the verge of a breakdown.
casting: Greg Kinnear, Toni Collette, Steve Carell, Paul Dano, Abigail Breslin
synopsis: A family loaded with quirky, colorful characters piles into an old van and road trips to California for little Olive to compete in a beauty pageant.

title: Hustle
tagline: Never quit on your dreams.
casting: Adam Sandler, Queen Latifah, Juancho Hernangómez, Ben Foster, Kenny Smith
synopsis: After discovering a once-in-a-lifetime player with a rocky past abroad, a down on his luck basketball scout takes it upon himself to bring the phenom to the States without his team's approval. Against the odds, they have one final shot to prove they have what it takes to make it in the NBA.

title: Jaws
tagline: The terrifying motion picture from the terrifying No. 1 best seller.
casting: Roy Scheider, Robert Shaw, Richard Dreyfuss, Lorraine Gary, Murray Hamilton
synopsis: When the seaside community of Amity finds itself under attack by a dangerous great white shark, the town's chief of police, a young marine biologist, and a grizzled shark hunter embark on a desperate quest to kill the beast before it strikes again.

title: Gran Turismo
tagline: From gamer to racer.
casting: Archie Madekwe, David Harbour, Orlando Bloom, Djimon Hounsou, Darren Barnet
synopsis: The ultimate wish-fulfillment tale of a teenage Gran Turismo player whose gaming skills won him a series of Nissan competitions to become an actual professional racecar driver.

title: The Count of Monte Cristo
tagline: Prepare for adventure. Count on revenge.
casting: Jim Caviezel, Guy Pearce, Richard Harris, James Frain, Dagmara Dominczyk
synopsis: Young sailor Edmond Dantès is wrongfully imprisoned, escapes, finds treasure, and reinvents himself as the wealthy Count of Monte Cristo to exact revenge on those who betrayed him.

title: Arrietty
tagline: Discover a secret world within our own.
casting: Mirai Shida, Ryunosuke Kamiki, Tomokazu Miura, Keiko Takeshita, Kirin Kiki
synopsis: 14-year-old Arrietty and the rest of the Clock family live in peaceful anonymity as they make their own home from items "borrowed" from the house's human inhabitants. However, life changes for the Clocks when a human boy discovers Arrietty.

title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
tagline: Training is over. The adventure begins.
casting: Jay Baruchel, Cate Blanchett, Gerard Butler, Craig Ferguson, America Ferrera
synopsis: Five years after uniting the dragons and Vikings of Berk, Hiccup and Toothless soar beyond their homeland, charting the vast unknown. During one of their adventures, the pair discover a secret cave that houses hundreds of wild dragons—and a mysterious dragon rider with a startling connection to Hiccup. And as the ruthless conqueror Drago Bludvist rises to seize control of both dragons and people alike, Hiccup must step into his role as a true leader and, alongside his friends and Toothless, protect Berk from a devastating war.

title: Black Swan
tagline: Perfection is not what it seems.
casting: Natalie Portman, Mila Kunis, Vincent Cassel, Barbara Hershey, Winona Ryder
synopsis: A committed dancer struggles to maintain her sanity after winning the lead role in a production of Tchaikovsky's "Swan Lake."

title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
tagline: Dark secrets revealed.
casting: Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Jim Broadbent, Michael Gambon
synopsis: Dumbledore tries to prepare Harry for the final battle with Voldemort while Death Eaters wreak havoc in both Muggle and Wizard worlds.

title: Moonrise Kingdom
tagline: A story of young love, wild adventures, and a very neat escape.
casting: Jared Gilman, Kara Hayward, Bruce Willis, Edward Norton, Bill Murray
synopsis: Set on an island off the coast of New England in the summer of 1965, Moonrise Kingdom tells the story of two twelve-year-olds who fall in love, make a secret pact, and run away together into the wilderness. As various authorities try to hunt them down, a violent storm is brewing off-shore – and the peaceful island community is turned upside down in more ways than anyone can handle.

title: Mississippi Burning
tagline: 1964. When America was at war with itself.
casting: Gene Hackman, Willem Dafoe, Frances McDormand, Brad Dourif, R. Lee Ermey
synopsis: Two FBI agents investigating the murder of civil rights workers during the 60s seek to breach the conspiracy of silence in a small Southern town where segregation divides black and white. The younger agent trained in FBI school runs up against the small town ways of his partner, a former sheriff.

title: The Batman
tagline: Unmask the truth.
casting: Robert Pattinson, Zoë Kravitz, Jeffrey Wright, Colin Farrell, Paul Dano
synopsis: In his second year of fighting crime, Batman uncovers corruption in Gotham City that connects to his own family while facing a serial killer known as the Riddler.

title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
tagline: The rebellion begins.
casting: Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Imelda Staunton, Helena Bonham Carter
synopsis: When a new professor's methods leave Hogwarts unprepared to fight the rising tide of evil, Harry teaches students how to defend against the dark arts.

title: Apocalypto
tagline: No one can outrun their destiny.
casting: Rudy Youngblood, Raoul Max Trujillo, Gerardo Taracena, Iazua Larios, Antonio Monroy
synopsis: Set in the Mayan civilization, when a man's idyllic presence is brutally disrupted by a violent invading force, he is taken on a perilous journey to a world ruled by fear and oppression where a harrowing end awaits him. Through a twist of fate and spurred by the power of his love for his woman and his family he will make a desperate break to return home and to ultimately save his way of life.

title: Remember the Titans
tagline: History is written by the winners.
casting: Denzel Washington, Will Patton, Wood Harris, Ryan Hurst, Donald Faison
synopsis: After leading his football team to 15 winning seasons, coach Bill Yoast is demoted and replaced by Herman Boone – tough, opinionated and as different from the beloved Yoast as he could be. The two men learn to overcome their differences and turn a group of hostile young men into champions.

title: Cast Away
tagline: At the edge of the world, his journey begins.
casting: Tom Hanks, Helen Hunt, Nick Searcy, Jenifer Lewis, Geoffrey Blake
synopsis: Chuck Noland, a top international manager for FedEx, and Kelly, a Ph.D. student, are in love and heading towards marriage. Then Chuck's plane to Malaysia crashes at sea during a terrible storm. He's the only survivor, and finds himself marooned on a desolate island. With no way to escape, Chuck must find ways to survive in his new home.

title: Zootopia 2
tagline: They're back with a twissst.
casting: Ginnifer Goodwin, Jason Bateman, Ke Huy Quan, Fortune Feimster, Andy Samberg
synopsis: After cracking the biggest case in Zootopia's history, rookie cops Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde find themselves on the twisting trail of a great mystery when Gary De'Snake arrives and turns the animal metropolis upside down. To crack the case, Judy and Nick must go undercover to unexpected new parts of town, where their growing partnership is tested like never before.

title: Iron Man
tagline: Heroes aren't born. They're built.
casting: Robert Downey Jr., Terrence Howard, Jeff Bridges, Gwyneth Paltrow, Leslie Bibb
synopsis: After being held captive in an Afghan cave, billionaire engineer Tony Stark creates a unique weaponized suit of armor to fight evil.

title: Primal Fear
tagline: Sooner or later, a man who wears two faces forgets which one is real.
casting: Richard Gere, Laura Linney, Edward Norton, John Mahoney, Alfre Woodard
synopsis: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.

title: All the President's Men
tagline: The most devastating detective story of this century.
casting: Dustin Hoffman, Robert Redford, Jack Warden, Martin Balsam, Hal Holbrook
synopsis: During the 1972 elections, two reporters' investigation sheds light on the controversial Watergate scandal that compels President Nixon to resign from his post.

title: The Gentlemen
tagline: Criminal. Class.
casting: Matthew McConaughey, Charlie Hunnam, Michelle Dockery, Jeremy Strong, Lyne Renee
synopsis: American expat Mickey Pearson has built a highly profitable marijuana empire in London. When word gets out that he’s looking to cash out of the business forever it triggers plots, schemes, bribery and blackmail in an attempt to steal his domain out from under him.

title: The Blind Side
tagline: Based on the extraordinary true story
casting: Sandra Bullock, Tim McGraw, Quinton Aaron, Jae Head, Lily Collins
synopsis: The story of Michael Oher, a homeless and traumatized boy who became an All American football player and first round NFL draft pick with the help of a caring woman and her family.

title: Aladdin
tagline: Imagine if you had three wishes, three hopes, three dreams and they all could come true.
casting: Scott Weinger, Robin Williams, Linda Larkin, Jonathan Freeman, Gilbert Gottfried
synopsis: In the boorish city of Agrabah, kind-hearted street urchin Aladdin and Princess Jasmine fall in love, although she can only marry a prince. He and power-hungry Grand Vizier Jafar vie for a magic lamp that can fulfill their wishes.

title: Brazil
tagline: It's only a state of mind.
casting: Jonathan Pryce, Robert De Niro, Katherine Helmond, Ian Holm, Bob Hoskins
synopsis: Low-level bureaucrat Sam Lowry escapes the monotony of his day-to-day life through a recurring daydream of himself as a virtuous hero saving a beautiful damsel. Investigating a case that led to the wrongful arrest and eventual death of an innocent man instead of wanted terrorist Harry Tuttle, he meets the woman from his daydream, and in trying to help her gets caught in a web of mistaken identities, mindless bureaucracy and lies.

title: Planet of the Apes
tagline: Somewhere in the Universe, there must be something better than man!
casting: Charlton Heston, Roddy McDowall, Kim Hunter, Maurice Evans, James Whitmore
synopsis: Astronaut Taylor crash lands on a distant planet ruled by apes who use a primitive race of humans for experimentation and sport. Soon Taylor finds himself among the hunted, his life in the hands of a benevolent chimpanzee scientist.

title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
tagline: In heroes we trust.
casting: Chris Evans, Samuel L. Jackson, Scarlett Johansson, Robert Redford, Sebastian Stan
synopsis: After the cataclysmic events in New York with The Avengers, Steve Rogers, aka Captain America is living quietly in Washington, D.C. and trying to adjust to the modern world. But when a S.H.I.E.L.D. colleague comes under attack, Steve becomes embroiled in a web of intrigue that threatens to put the world at risk. Joining forces with the Black Widow, Captain America struggles to expose the ever-widening conspiracy while fighting off professional assassins sent to silence him at every turn. When the full scope of the villainous plot is revealed, Captain America and the Black Widow enlist the help of a new ally, the Falcon. However, they soon find themselves up against an unexpected and formidable enemy—the Winter Soldier.

title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
tagline: Life is a terrible thing to sleep through.
casting: Johnny Depp, Leonardo DiCaprio, Juliette Lewis, Mary Steenburgen, Darlene Cates
synopsis: Gilbert Grape is a small-town young man with a lot of responsibility. Chief among his concerns are his mother, who is so overweight that she can't leave the house, and his mentally impaired younger brother, Arnie, who has a knack for finding trouble. Settled into a job at a grocery store and an ongoing affair with local woman Betty Carver, Gilbert finally has his life shaken up by the free-spirited Becky.

title: Aftersun
tagline: Memory burns.
casting: Paul Mescal, Frankie Corio, Brooklyn Toulson, Celia Rowlson-Hall, Sally Messham
synopsis: Sophie reflects on the shared joy and private melancholy of a holiday she took with her father twenty years earlier. Memories fill the gaps between camcorder footages as she tries to reconcile the father she knew with the troubled man she didn't.

title: The Trial of the Chicago 7
tagline: In 1968, democracy refused to back down.
casting: Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen, Mark Rylance, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Frank Langella
synopsis: What was supposed to be a peaceful protest turned into a violent clash with the police. What followed was one of the most notorious trials in history.

title: Nosferatu
tagline: A symphony of horror.
casting: Max Schreck, Gustav von Wangenheim, Greta Schröder, Georg H. Schnell, Ruth Landshoff
synopsis: The mysterious Count Orlok summons a happily married real estate agent to his castle, located up in the Transylvanian mountains, to finalise a terrifying deal.

title: Kubo and the Two Strings
tagline: If you must blink, do it now!
casting: Art Parkinson, Charlize Theron, Matthew McConaughey, Brenda Vaccaro, Ralph Fiennes
synopsis: Kubo mesmerizes the people in his village with his magical gift for spinning wild tales with origami. When he accidentally summons an evil spirit seeking vengeance, Kubo is forced to go on a quest to solve the mystery of his fallen samurai father and his mystical weaponry, as well as discover his own magical powers.

title: Amores Perros
tagline: Love. Betrayal. Death.
casting: Emilio Echevarría, Gael García Bernal, Goya Toledo, Álvaro Guerrero, Vanessa Bauche
synopsis: A fatalistic car crash in Mexico city sets off a chain of events in the lives of three people: a supermodel, a young man wanting to run off with his sister-in-law, and a homeless man.

title: The Holdovers
tagline: Discomfort and joy.
casting: Paul Giamatti, Dominic Sessa, Da'Vine Joy Randolph, Carrie Preston, Brady Hepner
synopsis: A curmudgeonly instructor at a New England prep school is forced to remain on campus during Christmas break to babysit the handful of students with nowhere to go. Eventually, he forms an unlikely bond with one of them — a damaged, brainy troublemaker — and with the school’s head cook, who has just lost a son in Vietnam.

title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
tagline: The world of Pandora will change forever.
casting: Sam Worthington, Zoe Saldaña, Sigourney Weaver, Stephen Lang, Oona Chaplin
synopsis: In the wake of the devastating war against the RDA and the loss of their eldest son, Jake Sully and Neytiri face a new threat on Pandora: the Ash People, a violent and power-hungry Na'vi tribe led by the ruthless Varang. Jake's family must fight for their survival and the future of Pandora in a conflict that pushes them to their emotional and physical limits.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
tagline: Live. Die. Repeat.
casting: Tom Cruise, Emily Blunt, Brendan Gleeson, Bill Paxton, Jonas Armstrong
synopsis: Major Bill Cage is an officer who has never seen a day of combat when he is unceremoniously demoted and dropped into combat. Cage is killed within minutes, managing to take an alpha alien down with him. He awakens back at the beginning of the same day and is forced to fight and die again... and again - as physical contact with the alien has thrown him into a time loop.

title: Prey
tagline: They hunt to live. It lives to hunt.
casting: Amber Midthunder, Dakota Beavers, Michelle Thrush, Stormee Kipp, Julian Black Antelope
synopsis: When danger threatens her camp, the fierce and highly skilled Comanche warrior Naru sets out to protect her people. But the prey she stalks turns out to be a highly evolved alien predator with a technically advanced arsenal.

title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
tagline: Nature just got gangster.
casting: Sam Neill, Julian Dennison, Rima Te Wiata, Rachel House, Tioreore Ngatai-Melbourne
synopsis: Ricky is a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive.

title: A Dog's Purpose
tagline: Every dog happens for a reason.
casting: Josh Gad, KJ Apa, Britt Robertson, Juliet Rylance, Luke Kirby
synopsis: A dog goes on quest to discover his purpose in life over the course of several lifetimes with multiple owners.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
tagline: The future belongs to the mad.
casting: Tom Hardy, Charlize Theron, Nicholas Hoult, Hugh Keays-Byrne, Josh Helman
synopsis: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken, and most everyone is crazed fighting for the necessities of life. Within this world exist two rebels on the run who just might be able to restore order.

title: Boyz n the Hood
tagline: Once upon a time in South Central L.A. ... It ain't no fairy tale.
casting: Cuba Gooding Jr., Laurence Fishburne, Ice Cube, Morris Chestnut, Angela Bassett
synopsis: Three friends growing up in South Central Los Angeles navigate a neighborhood plagued by violence, unemployment, and crime, each responding differently to the harsh realities of street life. As tragedy strikes close to home, their friendship, choices, and hopes for a better future are put to the ultimate test.

title: All the Bright Places
tagline: Live life at full brightness
casting: Elle Fanning, Justice Smith, Alexandra Shipp, Kelli O'Hara, Lamar Johnson
synopsis: Two teens facing personal struggles form a powerful bond as they embark on a cathartic journey chronicling the wonders of Indiana.

title: Arrival
tagline: Why are they here?
casting: Amy Adams, Jeremy Renner, Forest Whitaker, Michael Stuhlbarg, Mark O'Brien
synopsis: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat.

title: The Longest Ride
tagline: Two couples. Two love stories. One epic tale.
casting: Britt Robertson, Scott Eastwood, Alan Alda, Jack Huston, Oona Chaplin
synopsis: The lives of a young couple intertwine with a much older man as he reflects back on a lost love while he's trapped in an automobile crash.

title: Groundhog Day
tagline: He’s having the worst day of his life… Over and over again.
casting: Bill Murray, Andie MacDowell, Chris Elliott, Stephen Tobolowsky, Brian Doyle-Murray
synopsis: A cynical TV weatherman, along with his idealistic producer and his sardonic cameraman, is sent to report on Groundhog Day in the small town of Punxsutawney, where he finds himself repeating the same day over and over.

title: Boogie Nights
tagline: The life of a dreamer, the days of a business and the nights in between.
casting: Mark Wahlberg, Burt Reynolds, Julianne Moore, John C. Reilly, Heather Graham
synopsis: In 1977, an idealistic porn producer and his promising protege try to catch up with the end of an era before their never-ending party collides with cold, hard reality.

title: Atonement
tagline: Torn apart by betrayal. Separated by war. Bound by love.
casting: James McAvoy, Keira Knightley, Saoirse Ronan, Romola Garai, Vanessa Redgrave
synopsis: A young girl irrevocably changes the course of several lives when she accuses her older sister's lover of a crime he did not commit.

title: Memoirs of a Geisha
tagline: A story like mine has never been told.
casting: Zhang Ziyi, Gong Li, Michelle Yeoh, Ken Watanabe, Suzuka Ohgo
synopsis: In the years before World War II, a penniless Japanese child is torn from her family to work as a maid in a geisha house.

title: Onward
tagline: Their quest beginneth.
casting: Tom Holland, Chris Pratt, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Octavia Spencer, Mel Rodriguez
synopsis: In a suburban fantasy world, two teenage elf brothers embark on an extraordinary quest to discover if there is still a little magic left out there.

title: The Graduate
tagline: This is Benjamin. He’s a little worried about his future.
casting: Dustin Hoffman, Anne Bancroft, Katharine Ross, William Daniels, Murray Hamilton
synopsis: A disillusioned college graduate finds himself torn between his older lover and her daughter.

title: The Little Prince
tagline: Growing up isn't the problem... forgetting is.
casting: Riley Osborne, Mackenzie Foy, Jeff Bridges, Rachel McAdams, Marion Cotillard
synopsis: Based on the best-seller book 'The Little Prince', the movie tells the story of a little girl that lives with resignation in a world where efficiency and work are the only dogmas. Everything will change when accidentally she discovers her neighbor that will tell her about the story of the Little Prince that he once met.

title: Another Round
tagline: What is youth? A dream. What is love? The content of the dream.
casting: Mads Mikkelsen, Thomas Bo Larsen, Magnus Millang, Lars Ranthe, Maria Bonnevie
synopsis: Four stagnant high school teachers decide to test out a theory that maintaining a constant level of intoxication will improve their overall lives.

title: Deadpool
tagline: Feel the love.
casting: Ryan Reynolds, Morena Baccarin, Ed Skrein, T.J. Miller, Gina Carano
synopsis: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.

title: Get Out
tagline: Just because you're invited, doesn't mean you're welcome.
casting: Daniel Kaluuya, Allison Williams, Catherine Keener, Bradley Whitford, Caleb Landry Jones
synopsis: Chris and his girlfriend Rose go upstate to visit her parents for the weekend. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behavior as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries lead him to a truth that he never could have imagined.

title: Detachment
casting: Adrien Brody, Marcia Gay Harden, James Caan, Christina Hendricks, Lucy Liu
synopsis: A chronicle of three weeks in the lives of several high school teachers, administrators and students through the eyes of substitute teacher Henry Barthes. Henry roams from school to school, imparting modes of knowledge, but never staying long enough to form any semblance of sentient attachment.

title: Poor Things
tagline: She’s nothing like you’ve ever seen.
casting: Emma Stone, Mark Ruffalo, Willem Dafoe, Ramy Youssef, Christopher Abbott
synopsis: Brought back to life by an unorthodox scientist, a young woman runs off with a lawyer on a whirlwind adventure across the continents. Free from the prejudices of her times, she grows steadfast in her purpose to stand for equality and liberation.

title: Toy Story 2
tagline: The toys are back!
casting: Tom Hanks, Tim Allen, Joan Cusack, Kelsey Grammer, Don Rickles
synopsis: Andy heads off to Cowboy Camp, leaving his toys to their own devices. Things shift into high gear when an obsessive toy collector named Al McWhiggen, owner of Al's Toy Barn kidnaps Woody. Andy's toys mount a daring rescue mission, Buzz Lightyear meets his match and Woody has to decide where he and his heart truly belong.

title: The Man from Earth
tagline: From one of the acclaimed writers of Star Trek and The Twilight Zone comes a story that transcends both time and space...
casting: David Lee Smith, Tony Todd, John Billingsley, Ellen Crawford, Annika Peterson
synopsis: A departing professor gathers his closest colleagues for an intimate farewell, but the night takes an unexpected turn when he shares a stunning secret about his past. As the conversation unfolds, skepticism and curiosity collide, challenging everything they thought they knew about history, science, and belief.

title: The Others
tagline: Sooner or later they’ll find you.
casting: Nicole Kidman, Alakina Mann, James Bentley, Fionnula Flanagan, Christopher Eccleston
synopsis: Grace is a religious woman who lives in an old house kept dark because her two children, Anne and Nicholas, have a rare sensitivity to light. When the family begins to suspect the house is haunted, Grace fights to protect her children at any cost in the face of strange events and disturbing visions.

title: Tangled
tagline: They're taking adventure to new lengths.
casting: Mandy Moore, Zachary Levi, Donna Murphy, Ron Perlman, M.C. Gainey
synopsis: Feisty teenager Rapunzel, who has long and magical hair, wants to go and see sky lanterns on her eighteenth birthday, but she's bound to a tower by her overprotective mother. She strikes a deal with Flynn Rider, a charming wanted thief, and the duo set off on an action-packed escapade.

title: Children of Men
tagline: The year 2027: the last days of the human race. No child has been born for 18 years. He must protect our only hope.
casting: Clive Owen, Clare-Hope Ashitey, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Julianne Moore, Michael Caine
synopsis: In 2027, in a chaotic world in which humans can no longer procreate, a former activist agrees to help transport a miraculously pregnant woman to a sanctuary at sea, where her child's birth may help scientists save the future of humankind.

title: Kingsman: The Secret Service
tagline: Manners maketh man.
casting: Taron Egerton, Colin Firth, Samuel L. Jackson, Mark Strong, Sophie Cookson
synopsis: The story of a super-secret spy organization that recruits an unrefined but promising street kid into the agency's ultra-competitive training program just as a global threat emerges from a twisted tech genius.

title: Roma
tagline: There are periods in history that scar societies and moments in life that transform us as individuals.
casting: Yalitza Aparicio, Marina de Tavira, Diego Cortina Autrey, Carlos Peralta, Marco Graf
synopsis: In 1970s Mexico City, two domestic workers help a mother of four while her husband is away for an extended period of time.

title: The Last Samurai
tagline: In the face of an enemy, in the heart of one man, lies the soul of a warrior.
casting: Tom Cruise, Ken Watanabe, Timothy Spall, Tony Goldwyn, Hiroyuki Sanada
synopsis: Nathan Algren is an American hired to instruct the Japanese army in the ways of modern warfare, which finds him learning to respect the samurai and the honorable principles that rule them. Pressed to destroy the samurai's way of life in the name of modernization and open trade, Algren decides to become an ultimate warrior himself and to fight for their right to exist.

title: The Raid 2
tagline: It's not over yet.
casting: Iko Uwais, Arifin Putra, Tio Pakusadewo, Oka Antara, Alex Abbad
synopsis: After fighting his way through an apartment building populated by an army of dangerous criminals and escaping with his life, SWAT team member Rama goes undercover, joining a powerful Indonesian crime syndicate to protect his family and uncover corrupt members of his own force.

title: Twelve Monkeys
tagline: The future is history.
casting: Bruce Willis, Madeleine Stowe, Brad Pitt, Christopher Plummer, David Morse
synopsis: In the year 2035, convict James Cole reluctantly volunteers to be sent back in time to discover the origin of a deadly virus that wiped out nearly all of the earth's population and forced the survivors into underground communities. But when Cole is mistakenly sent to 1990 instead of 1996, he's arrested and locked up in a mental hospital. There he meets psychiatrist Dr. Kathryn Railly and the son of a famous virus expert who may hold the key to the Army of the 12 Monkeys; thought to be responsible for unleashing the killer disease.

title: Avatar
tagline: Enter the world of Pandora.
casting: Sam Worthington, Zoe Saldaña, Sigourney Weaver, Stephen Lang, Michelle Rodriguez
synopsis: In the 22nd century, a paraplegic Marine is dispatched to the moon Pandora on a unique mission, but becomes torn between following orders and protecting an alien civilization.

title: Blade Runner 2049
tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.
casting: Ryan Gosling, Harrison Ford, Ana de Armas, Dave Bautista, Robin Wright
synopsis: Thirty years after the events of the first film, a new blade runner, LAPD Officer K, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. K's discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former LAPD blade runner who has been missing for 30 years.

title: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
tagline: Not that it matters, but most of it is true.
casting: Paul Newman, Robert Redford, Katharine Ross, Strother Martin, Henry Jones
synopsis: As the west rapidly becomes civilized, a pair of outlaws in 1890s Wyoming find themselves pursued by a posse and decide to flee to South America in hopes of evading the law.

title: Breakfast at Tiffany's
tagline: Audrey Hepburn plays that daring, darling Holly Golightly to a new high in entertainment delight!
casting: Audrey Hepburn, George Peppard, Patricia Neal, Buddy Ebsen, Martin Balsam
synopsis: Holly Golightly is an eccentric New York City playgirl determined to marry a Brazilian millionaire. But when young writer Paul Varjak moves into her apartment building, her past threatens to get in their way.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
tagline: Obviously.
casting: Chris Pratt, Zoe Saldaña, Dave Bautista, Vin Diesel, Bradley Cooper
synopsis: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.

title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
tagline: Life isn't measured in minutes, but in moments.
casting: Brad Pitt, Cate Blanchett, Taraji P. Henson, Julia Ormond, Jason Flemyng
synopsis: Born under unusual circumstances, Benjamin Button springs into being as an elderly man in a New Orleans nursing home and ages in reverse. Twelve years after his birth, he meets Daisy, a child who flits in and out of his life as she grows up to be a dancer. Though he has all sorts of unusual adventures over the course of his life, it is his relationship with Daisy, and the hope that they will come together at the right time, that drives Benjamin forward.

title: Blue Velvet
tagline: It's a strange world, isn't it?
casting: Isabella Rossellini, Kyle MacLachlan, Dennis Hopper, Laura Dern, Hope Lange
synopsis: The discovery of a severed human ear found in a field leads a young man on an investigation related to a beautiful, mysterious nightclub singer and a group of psychopathic criminals who have kidnapped her child.

title: All About My Mother
tagline: Part of every woman is a mother/actress/saint/sinner. And part of every man is a woman.
casting: Cecilia Roth, Marisa Paredes, Candela Peña, Antonia San Juan, Penélope Cruz
synopsis: Following the tragic death of her teenage son, Manuela travels from Madrid to Barcelona in an attempt to contact the long-estranged father the boy never knew. She reunites with an old friend, an outspoken transgender sex worker, and befriends a troubled actress and a pregnant, HIV-positive nun.

title: Godzilla Minus One
tagline: 戦後、日本。無（ゼロ）から負（マイナス）へ。
casting: Ryunosuke Kamiki, Minami Hamabe, Yuki Yamada, Munetaka Aoki, Hidetaka Yoshioka
synopsis: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

title: Sleepers
tagline: Four friends have made a mistake that will change their lives forever.
casting: Kevin Bacon, Robert De Niro, Dustin Hoffman, Bruno Kirby, Jason Patric
synopsis: Two gangsters seek revenge on the state jail worker who during their stay at a youth prison sexually abused them. A sensational court hearing takes place to charge him for the crimes.

title: Night of the Living Dead
tagline: If it doesn't scare you, you're already dead!
casting: Judith O'Dea, Duane Jones, Marilyn Eastman, Karl Hardman, Judith Ridley
synopsis: A ragtag group barricade themselves in an old Pennsylvania farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls ravaging the Northeast.

title: Anastasia
tagline: Discover the adventure behind the greatest mystery of our time.
casting: Meg Ryan, John Cusack, Kelsey Grammer, Christopher Lloyd, Hank Azaria
synopsis: Ten years after she was separated from her family, an eighteen-year-old orphan with vague memories of the past sets out to Paris in hopes of reuniting with her grandmother. She is accompanied by two con men, who intend to pass her off as the Grand Duchess Anastasia to the Dowager Empress for a reward.

title: Billy Elliot
tagline: Inside every one of us is a special talent waiting to come out. The trick is finding it.
casting: Jamie Bell, Gary Lewis, Julie Walters, Jean Heywood, Jamie Draven
synopsis: County Durham, England, 1984. The miners' strike has started and the police have started coming up from Bethnal Green, starting a class war with the lower classes suffering. Caught in the middle of the conflict is 11-year old Billy Elliot, who, after leaving his boxing club for the day, stumbles upon a ballet class and finds out that he's naturally talented. He practices with his teacher Mrs. Wilkinson for an upcoming audition in Newcastle-upon Tyne for the royal Ballet school in London.

title: Frankenstein
tagline: Only monsters play God.
casting: Oscar Isaac, Jacob Elordi, Christoph Waltz, Mia Goth, Felix Kammerer
synopsis: Dr. Victor Frankenstein, a brilliant but egotistical scientist, brings a creature to life in a monstrous experiment that ultimately leads to the undoing of both the creator and his tragic creation.

title: 10 Things I Hate About You
tagline: How do I loathe thee? Let me count the ways.
casting: Heath Ledger, Julia Stiles, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Larisa Oleynik, David Krumholtz
synopsis: On the first day at his new school, Cameron instantly falls for Bianca, the gorgeous girl of his dreams. The only problem is that Bianca is forbidden to date until her ill-tempered, completely un-dateable older sister Kat goes out, too. In an attempt to solve his problem, Cameron singles out the only guy who could possibly be a match for Kat: a mysterious bad boy with a nasty reputation of his own.

title: Seven Pounds
tagline: Seven names. Seven strangers. One secret.
casting: Will Smith, Rosario Dawson, Woody Harrelson, Michael Ealy, Barry Pepper
synopsis: An IRS agent with a fateful secret embarks on an extraordinary journey of redemption by forever changing the lives of seven strangers.

title: American Gangster
tagline: There are two sides to the American dream.
casting: Denzel Washington, Russell Crowe, Josh Brolin, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Cuba Gooding Jr.
synopsis: Loosely based on the criminal career of Frank Lucas, a gangster from La Grange, North Carolina, who smuggled heroin into the United States on American service planes returning from the Vietnam War, before being detained by a task force led by Newark Detective Richie Roberts.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
tagline: New adventure. New rival.
casting: Ben Schwartz, Jim Carrey, Keanu Reeves, Idris Elba, Colleen O'Shaughnessey
synopsis: Sonic, Knuckles, and Tails reunite against a powerful new adversary, Shadow, a mysterious villain with powers unlike anything they have faced before. With their abilities outmatched in every way, Team Sonic must seek out an unlikely alliance in hopes of stopping Shadow and protecting the planet.

title: The Kissing Booth 2
tagline: Rules can be broken...but so can hearts.
casting: Joey King, Jacob Elordi, Joel Courtney, Molly Ringwald, Taylor Zakhar Perez
synopsis: With college decisions looming, Elle juggles her long-distance romance with Noah, changing relationship with bestie Lee and feelings for a new classmate.

title: King Richard
tagline: Venus, Serena and a plan for greatness.
casting: Will Smith, Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor, Saniyya Sidney, Demi Singleton, Jon Bernthal
synopsis: The story of how Richard Williams served as a coach to his daughters Venus and Serena, who will soon become two of the most legendary tennis players in history.

title: Corpse Bride
tagline: There's been a grave misunderstanding.
casting: Johnny Depp, Helena Bonham Carter, Emily Watson, Tracey Ullman, Paul Whitehouse
synopsis: In a 19th-century European village, a young man about to be married is whisked away to the underworld and wed to a mysterious corpse bride, while his real bride waits bereft in the land of the living.

title: Thelma & Louise
tagline: Somebody said get a life...so they did.
casting: Susan Sarandon, Geena Davis, Harvey Keitel, Michael Madsen, Christopher McDonald
synopsis: Taking a break from their dreary lives, close friends Thelma and Louise embark on a short weekend trip that ends in unforeseen incriminating circumstances. As fugitives, both women rediscover the strength of their bond and their newfound resilience.

title: JFK
tagline: The story that won't go away.
casting: Kevin Costner, Tommy Lee Jones, Gary Oldman, Kevin Bacon, Michael Rooker
synopsis: Follows the investigation into the assassination of President John F. Kennedy led by New Orleans district attorney Jim Garrison.

title: The Fifth Element
tagline: There is no future without it.
casting: Bruce Willis, Milla Jovovich, Gary Oldman, Ian Holm, Chris Tucker
synopsis: In 2257, a taxi driver is unintentionally given the task of saving a young girl who is part of the key that will ensure the survival of humanity.

title: The Last Emperor
tagline: 1500 slaves. 353,260,000 royal subjects. Warlords. Concubines. And 2 wives. He was the loneliest boy in the world.
casting: John Lone, Joan Chen, Peter O'Toole, Ruocheng Ying, Victor Wong
synopsis: A dramatic history of Pu Yi, the last of the Emperors of China, from his lofty birth and brief reign in the Forbidden City, the object of worship by half a billion people; through his abdication, his decline and dissolute lifestyle; his exploitation by the invading Japanese, and finally to his obscure existence as just another peasant worker in the People's Republic.

title: Elemental
tagline: Opposites react.
casting: Leah Lewis, Mamoudou Athie, Ronnie del Carmen, Shila Ommi, Wendi McLendon-Covey
synopsis: In a city where fire, water, land and air residents live together, a fiery young woman and a go-with-the-flow guy will discover something elemental: how much they have in common.

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
tagline: Come together.
casting: Ryan Reynolds, Hugh Jackman, Emma Corrin, Matthew Macfadyen, Dafne Keen
synopsis: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.

title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
tagline: Not all heroes wear capes. Some wear overalls.
casting: Chris Pratt, Anya Taylor-Joy, Charlie Day, Jack Black, Keegan-Michael Key
synopsis: While working underground to fix a water main, Brooklyn plumbers—and brothers—Mario and Luigi are transported down a mysterious pipe and wander into a magical new world. But when the brothers are separated, Mario embarks on an epic quest to find Luigi.

title: To All the Boys I've Loved Before
tagline: The letters are out.
casting: Lana Condor, Noah Centineo, Israel Broussard, Janel Parrish, Anna Cathcart
synopsis: Lara Jean's love life goes from imaginary to out of control when her secret letters to every boy she's ever fallen for are mysteriously mailed out.

title: The Fault in Our Stars
tagline: Life doesn't have to be perfect for love to be extraordinary.
casting: Shailene Woodley, Ansel Elgort, Nat Wolff, Laura Dern, Sam Trammell
synopsis: Despite the tumor-shrinking medical miracle that has bought her a few years, Hazel has never been anything but terminal, her final chapter inscribed upon diagnosis. But when a patient named Augustus Waters suddenly appears at Cancer Kid Support Group, Hazel's story is about to be completely rewritten.

title: Coach Carter
tagline: It begins on the streets. It ends here.
casting: Samuel L. Jackson, Rob Brown, Robert Ri'chard, Rick Gonzalez, Nana Gbewonyo
synopsis: Based on a true story, in which Richmond High School head basketball coach Ken Carter made headlines in 1999 for benching his undefeated team due to poor academic results.

title: Cinderella Man
tagline: One man's extraordinary fight to save the family he loved.
casting: Russell Crowe, Renée Zellweger, Paul Giamatti, Craig Bierko, Paddy Considine
synopsis: The true story of boxer Jim Braddock who, following his retirement in the 1930s, makes a surprise comeback in order to lift his family out of poverty.

title: Predator
tagline: Soon the hunt will begin.
casting: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Carl Weathers, Kevin Peter Hall, Elpidia Carrillo, Bill Duke
synopsis: A team of elite commandos on a secret mission in a Central American jungle come to find themselves hunted by an extraterrestrial warrior.

title: Ready Player One
tagline: A better reality awaits.
casting: Tye Sheridan, Olivia Cooke, Ben Mendelsohn, Lena Waithe, T.J. Miller
synopsis: When the creator of a popular video game system dies, a virtual contest is created to compete for his fortune.

title: The Garden of Words
casting: Miyu Irino, Kana Hanazawa, Fumi Hirano, Takeshi Maeda, Yuka Terasaki
synopsis: Takao, who is training to become a shoemaker, skipped school and is sketching shoes in a Japanese-style garden. He meets a mysterious woman, Yukino, who is older than him. Then, without arranging the times, the two start to see each other again and again, but only on rainy days. They deepen their relationship and open up to each other. But the end of the rainy season soon approaches.

title: Drive
tagline: There are no clean getaways.
casting: Ryan Gosling, Carey Mulligan, Bryan Cranston, Albert Brooks, Oscar Isaac
synopsis: Driver is a skilled Hollywood stuntman who moonlights as a getaway driver for criminals. Though he projects an icy exterior, lately he's been warming up to a pretty neighbor named Irene and her young son, Benicio. When Irene's husband gets out of jail, he enlists Driver's help in a million-dollar heist. The job goes horribly wrong, and Driver must risk his life to protect Irene and Benicio from the vengeful masterminds behind the robbery.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
tagline: Return to Pandora.
casting: Sam Worthington, Zoe Saldaña, Sigourney Weaver, Stephen Lang, Kate Winslet
synopsis: Set more than a decade after the events of the first film, learn the story of the Sully family (Jake, Neytiri, and their kids), the trouble that follows them, the lengths they go to keep each other safe, the battles they fight to stay alive, and the tragedies they endure.

title: Tombstone
tagline: Every town has a story. Tombstone has a legend.
casting: Kurt Russell, Val Kilmer, Michael Biehn, Powers Boothe, Robert John Burke
synopsis: Legendary marshal Wyatt Earp, now a weary gunfighter, joins his brothers Morgan and Virgil to pursue their collective fortune in the thriving mining town of Tombstone. But Earp is forced to don a badge again and get help from his notorious pal Doc Holliday when a gang of renegade brigands and rustlers begins terrorizing the town.

title: Treasure Planet
tagline: Find your place in the universe.
casting: Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Brian Murray, Emma Thompson, David Hyde Pierce, Martin Short
genres: Science Fiction, Adventure, Animation, Family, Fantasy
synopsis: When space galleon cabin boy Jim Hawkins discovers a map to an intergalactic "loot of a thousand worlds," a cyborg cook named John Silver teaches him to battle supernovas and space storms on their journey to find treasure.

title: The Game
tagline: What do you get for the man who has everything...?
casting: Michael Douglas, Sean Penn, Deborah Kara Unger, James Rebhorn, Peter Donat
synopsis: In honor of his birthday, San Francisco banker Nicholas Van Orton, a financial genius and a cold-hearted loner, receives an unusual present from his younger brother, Conrad: a gift certificate to play a unique kind of game. In nary a nanosecond, Nicholas finds himself consumed by a dangerous set of ever-changing rules, unable to distinguish where the charade ends and reality begins.

title: The Wizard of Oz
tagline: We're off to see the Wizard, the wonderful Wizard of Oz!
casting: Judy Garland, Ray Bolger, Jack Haley, Bert Lahr, Frank Morgan
synopsis: Young Dorothy finds herself in a magical world where she makes friends with a lion, a scarecrow and a tin man as they make their way along the yellow brick road to talk with the Wizard and ask for the things they miss most in their lives. The Wicked Witch of the West is the only thing that could stop them.

title: tick, tick... BOOM!
tagline: How much time do we have to do something great?
casting: Andrew Garfield, Alexandra Shipp, Robin de Jesús, Michaela Jaé Rodriguez, Ben Levi Ross
synopsis: On the brink of turning 30, a promising theater composer navigates love, friendship and the pressure to create something great before time runs out.

title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
tagline: Beyond darkness... beyond desolation... lies the greatest danger of all.
casting: Ian McKellen, Martin Freeman, Richard Armitage, Benedict Cumberbatch, Orlando Bloom
synopsis: The Dwarves, Bilbo and Gandalf have successfully escaped the Misty Mountains, and Bilbo has gained the One Ring. They all continue their journey to get their gold back from the Dragon, Smaug.

title: Thor: Ragnarok
tagline: No hammer. No problem.
casting: Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo, Tom Hiddleston, Cate Blanchett, Idris Elba
synopsis: Thor is imprisoned on the other side of the universe and finds himself in a race against time to get back to Asgard to stop Ragnarok, the destruction of his home-world and the end of Asgardian civilization, at the hands of a powerful new threat, the ruthless Hela.

title: Casino Royale
tagline: Everyone has a past. Every legend has a beginning.
casting: Daniel Craig, Eva Green, Mads Mikkelsen, Judi Dench, Jeffrey Wright
synopsis: Le Chiffre, a banker to the world's terrorists, is scheduled to participate in a high-stakes poker game in Montenegro, where he intends to use his winnings to establish his financial grip on the terrorist market. M sends Bond—on his maiden mission as a 00 Agent—to attend this game and prevent Le Chiffre from winning. With the help of Vesper Lynd and Felix Leiter, Bond enters the most important poker game in his already dangerous career.

title: The Butterfly Effect
tagline: Change one thing. Change everything.
casting: Ashton Kutcher, Amy Smart, Melora Walters, Elden Henson, William Lee Scott
synopsis: A young man struggles to access sublimated childhood memories. He finds a technique that allows him to travel back into the past, to occupy his childhood body and change history. However, he soon finds that every change he makes has unexpected consequences.

title: Malena
tagline: Too young to be a widow, too beautiful to be alone.
casting: Monica Bellucci, Giuseppe Sulfaro, Luciano Federico, Matilde Piana, Pietro Notarianni
synopsis: 12-year-old Renato experiences three significant events on the same day: the beginning of the Second World War, getting a bike, and witnessing the arrival of the gorgeous Malèna. Through his eyes, we see the curse of beauty and loneliness of Malena, whose husband is presumed dead, and, through his soul, we see his love for her.

title: Wrath of Man
tagline: A one man army.
casting: Jason Statham, Holt McCallany, Rocci Williams, Josh Hartnett, Jeffrey Donovan
synopsis: A cold and mysterious new security guard for a Los Angeles cash truck company surprises his co-workers when he unleashes precision skills during a heist. The crew is left wondering who he is and where he came from. Soon, the marksman's ultimate motive becomes clear as he takes dramatic and irrevocable steps to settle a score.

title: Hot Fuzz
tagline: Big cops. Small town. Moderate violence.
casting: Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Jim Broadbent, Paddy Considine, Rafe Spall
synopsis: Former London constable Nicholas Angel finds it difficult to adapt to his new assignment in the sleepy British village of Sandford. Not only does he miss the excitement of the big city, but he also has a well-meaning oaf for a partner. However, when a series of grisly accidents rocks Sandford, Angel smells something rotten in the idyllic village.

title: Ex Machina
tagline: There is nothing more human than the will to survive.
casting: Domhnall Gleeson, Alicia Vikander, Oscar Isaac, Sonoya Mizuno, Corey Johnson
synopsis: Caleb, a coder at the world's largest internet company, wins a competition to spend a week at a private mountain retreat belonging to Nathan, the reclusive CEO of the company. But when Caleb arrives at the remote location he finds that he will have to participate in a strange and fascinating experiment in which he must interact with the world's first true artificial intelligence, housed in the body of a beautiful robot girl.

title: The Irishman
tagline: His story changed history.
casting: Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci, Harvey Keitel, Ray Romano
synopsis: Pennsylvania, 1956. Frank Sheeran, a war veteran of Irish origin who works as a truck driver, accidentally meets mobster Russell Bufalino. Once Frank becomes his trusted man, Bufalino sends him to Chicago with the task of helping Jimmy Hoffa, a powerful union leader related to organized crime, with whom Frank will maintain a close friendship for nearly twenty years.

title: Gattaca
tagline: There is no gene for the human spirit.
casting: Ethan Hawke, Uma Thurman, Jude Law, Alan Arkin, Loren Dean
synopsis: Vincent is an all-too-human man who dares to defy a system obsessed with genetic perfection. He is an "In-Valid" who assumes the identity of a member of the genetic elite to pursue his goal of traveling into space with the Gattaca Aerospace Corporation.

title: The Emperor's New Groove
tagline: It's all about... ME!
casting: David Spade, John Goodman, Eartha Kitt, Patrick Warburton, Wendie Malick
synopsis: When the self‑absorbed Emperor Kuzco is accidentally transformed into a llama, he must rely on a humble villager to survive the jungle and reclaim his throne.

title: Moana
tagline: The ocean is calling.
casting: Auliʻi Cravalho, Dwayne Johnson, Rachel House, Temuera Morrison, Jemaine Clement
synopsis: In Ancient Polynesia, when a terrible curse incurred by Maui reaches an impetuous Chieftain's daughter's island, she answers the Ocean's call to seek out the demigod to set things right.

title: Kramer vs. Kramer
tagline: There are three sides to this love story.
casting: Dustin Hoffman, Meryl Streep, Jane Alexander, Justin Henry, Howard Duff
synopsis: Ted Kramer is a career man for whom his work comes before his family. His wife Joanna cannot take this anymore, so she decides to leave him. Ted is now faced with the tasks of housekeeping and taking care of himself and their young son Billy.

title: Changeling
tagline: To find her son, she did what no one else dared.
casting: Angelina Jolie, John Malkovich, Jeffrey Donovan, Michael Kelly, Colm Feore
synopsis: Los Angeles, 1928. When single mother Christine Collins leaves for work, her son vanishes without a trace. Five months later, the police reunite mother and son. But when Christine suspects that the boy returned to her isn't her child, her quest for truth exposes a world of corruption.

title: Encanto
tagline: There's a little magic in all of us...almost all of us.
casting: Stephanie Beatriz, María Cecilia Botero, John Leguizamo, Mauro Castillo, Jess Darrow
synopsis: The tale of an extraordinary family, the Madrigals, who live hidden in the mountains of Colombia, in a magical house, in a vibrant town, in a wondrous, charmed place called an Encanto. The magic of the Encanto has blessed every child in the family—every child except one, Mirabel. But when she discovers that the magic surrounding the Encanto is in danger, Mirabel decides that she, the only ordinary Madrigal, might just be her exceptional family's last hope.

title: Moon
tagline: 250,000 miles from home, the hardest thing to face... is yourself.
casting: Sam Rockwell, Kevin Spacey, Dominique McElligott, Rosie Shaw, Adrienne Shaw
synopsis: With only three weeks left in his three-year contract, Sam Bell is eager to return to Earth. Stationed alone at a Moon-based facility with his computer assistant GERTY, an unexpected accident sets off a series of unsettling events that shake his isolation.

title: Searching
tagline: No one is lost without a trace.
casting: John Cho, Michelle La, Debra Messing, Joseph Lee, Sara Sohn
synopsis: After David Kim's 16-year-old daughter goes missing, a local investigation is opened and a detective is assigned to the case. But 37 hours later and without a single lead, David decides to search the one place no one has looked yet, where all secrets are kept today: his daughter's laptop.

title: Beautiful Boy
tagline: A true story of addiction, survival and family.
casting: Steve Carell, Timothée Chalamet, Maura Tierney, Amy Ryan, Christian Convery
synopsis: After he and his first wife separate, journalist David Sheff struggles to help their teenage son, who goes from experimenting with drugs to becoming devastatingly addicted to methamphetamine.

title: Lilo & Stitch
tagline: There's one in every family.
casting: Daveigh Chase, Chris Sanders, Tia Carrere, David Ogden Stiers, Kevin McDonald
synopsis: As Stitch, a runaway genetic experiment from a faraway planet, wreaks havoc on the Hawaiian Islands, he becomes the mischievous adopted alien "puppy" of an independent little girl named Lilo and learns about loyalty, friendship, and ʻohana, the Hawaiian tradition of family.

title: I Am Sam
tagline: Love is all you need.
casting: Sean Penn, Michelle Pfeiffer, Dianne Wiest, Dakota Fanning, Richard Schiff
synopsis: Sam, a neurodivergent man, has a daughter with a homeless woman who abandons them when they leave the hospital, leaving Sam to raise Lucy on his own. But as Lucy grows up, Sam's limitations as a parent start to become a problem and the authorities take her away. Sam convinces high-priced lawyer Rita to take his case pro bono and in turn teaches her the value of love and family.

title: A Few Good Men
tagline: In the heart of the nation's capital, in a courthouse of the U.S. government, one man will stop at nothing to keep his honor, and one will stop at nothing to find the truth.
casting: Tom Cruise, Jack Nicholson, Demi Moore, Kevin Bacon, Kevin Pollak
synopsis: When cocky military lawyer Lt. Daniel Kaffee and his co-counsel, Lt. Cmdr. JoAnne Galloway, are assigned to a murder case, they uncover a hazing ritual that could implicate high-ranking officials such as shady Col. Nathan Jessep.

title: Blood Diamond
tagline: It will cost you everything.
casting: Leonardo DiCaprio, Djimon Hounsou, Jennifer Connelly, Kagiso Kuypers, Arnold Vosloo
synopsis: An ex-mercenary turned smuggler. A Mende fisherman. Amid the explosive civil war overtaking 1999 Sierra Leone, these men join for two desperate missions: recovering a rare pink diamond of immense value and rescuing the fisherman's son, conscripted as a child soldier into the brutal rebel forces ripping a swath of torture and bloodshed countrywide.

title: Halloween
tagline: The night he came home!
casting: Donald Pleasence, Jamie Lee Curtis, Nancy Kyes, P. J. Soles, Charles Cyphers
synopsis: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.

title: I Origins
casting: Michael Pitt, Brit Marling, Àstrid Bergès-Frisbey, Steven Yeun, Archie Panjabi
synopsis: A molecular biologist's study of the human eye has far-reaching implications about humanity's scientific and spiritual beliefs.

title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
tagline: Leisure rules.
casting: Matthew Broderick, Alan Ruck, Mia Sara, Jeffrey Jones, Jennifer Grey
synopsis: After high school slacker Ferris Bueller successfully fakes an illness in order to skip school for the day, he goes on a series of adventures throughout Chicago with his girlfriend Sloane and best friend Cameron, all the while trying to outwit his wily school principal and fed-up sister.

title: The Woman King
tagline: Her reign begins.
casting: Viola Davis, Thuso Mbedu, Lashana Lynch, Sheila Atim, John Boyega
